import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem normalClosure_is_least_normal {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : Set G) :
  ∃ N : Subgroup G, N.Normal ∧ s ⊆ N ∧
    ∀ M : Subgroup G, M.Normal → s ⊆ M → N ≤ M := by
  let S : Set (Subgroup G) := {M | M.Normal ∧ s ⊆ (M : Set G)}
  have hNormal : (sInf S).Normal := by
    constructor
    intro n hn g
    have h_forall : ∀ M ∈ S, n ∈ M := Subgroup.mem_sInf.mp hn
    exact Subgroup.mem_sInf.mpr fun M hM => hM.1.conj_mem n (h_forall M hM) g
  refine ⟨sInf S, hNormal, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact Subgroup.mem_sInf.mpr fun M hM => hM.2 hx
  · intro M hM hs
    exact sInf_le ⟨hM, hs⟩
